entries.title: Hebrews 11:1
segments: Now faith is [the] substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:2
segments: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:3
segments: Through faith we understand that the ages were framed by a word of God, so that the things seen [should] not have come into being out of the things that appear.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:4
segments: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness [that he] was righteous, God testifying of his gifts. And by it he, being dead, yet speaks.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:5
segments: By faith Enoch was translated [so as] not to see death, and he was not found, because God had translated him; for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:6
segments: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [Him], for he who comes to God must believe that He is and [that] He is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:7
segments: By faith Noah, having been warned by God of things not yet seen, moved with fear, prepared an ark to [the] saving of his house, by which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness [which is by] faith.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:8
segments: By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out into a place which he was afterward going to receive for an inheritance. And [he] went out, not knowing where he went.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:9
segments: By faith he lived in the land of promise as [in] a strange [country], dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs of the same promise with him.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:10
segments: For he looked for a city which has foundations, whose builder and maker [is] God.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:11
segments: Through faith also Sarah herself received strength to conceive seed and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged Him who had promised [to be] faithful.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:12
segments: Because of this came into being [from] one, and that [from] one as good as dead, [seed] even as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the seashore.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:13
segments: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off. And they were persuaded of [them] and embraced [them] and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:14
segments: For they who say such things declare plainly that they seek a fatherland.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:15
segments: And truly, if they had been mindful of that [country] from which they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:16
segments: But now they stretch forth to a better [fatherland], that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:17
segments: By faith Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. And he who had received the promises offered up his only-begotten [son],

entries.title: Hebrews 11:18
segments: of whom it was said that in Isaac your Seed shall be called,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:19
segments: concluding that God [was] able to raise him up, even from [the] dead, from where he even received him, in a figure.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:20
segments: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:21
segments: By faith Jacob, [when he was] dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph and worshiped, [leaning] upon the top of his staff.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:22
segments: By faith, Joseph dying remembered concerning the Exodus of the sons of Israel and gave orders concerning his bones.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:23
segments: By faith Moses, having been born, was hidden three months by his parents, because they saw [he was] a beautiful child. And they were not afraid of the king's commandments.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:24
segments: Having become great, Moses by faith refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:25
segments: choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:26
segments: esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt, for he was looking to the reward.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:27
segments: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king, for he endured as seeing Him who is invisible.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:28
segments: Through faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, lest He who destroyed the first-born should touch them.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:29
segments: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as by dry [land], which the Egyptians attempting to do were drowned.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:30
segments: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been compassed seven days.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:31
segments: By faith the harlot Rahab did not perish with those who did not believe, when she had received the spies with peace.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:32
segments: And what more shall I say? For the time would fail me to tell of Gideon and Barak and Samson and Jephthah; also David, and Samuel and the prophets,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:33
segments: who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped [the] mouths of lions,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:34
segments: quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, became valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the strangers.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:35
segments: Women received their dead raised to life again, and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:36
segments: And others had trial of [cruel] mockings and scourgings; yes, more, of bonds and imprisonments.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:37
segments: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, were tempted, were slain with the sword. They wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins, being destitute, afflicted, tormented.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:38
segments: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains and dens and caves of the earth.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:39
segments: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, did not receive the promise,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:40
segments: for God had provided some better thing for us, that they should not be made perfect without us.
